candidate.basis: HONOR Australia confirms the Australian HONOR 600 product identity and 256GB configuration, while an Australian Woolworths marketplace listing explicitly identifies the global HONOR 600 5G 256GB as model VKJ-NX9.

Australian Woolworths marketplace listing identifies HONOR 600 5G 256GB global version as VKJ-NX9.
